terms.metaDescription: Terms governing the en primeur pre-order of Château Coutet wines on TERWA: allocations, price, availability, delivery and producer buy-back.
terms.title: Terms of sale

purpose.title: 1. Purpose
purpose.body: These terms govern the en primeur sale of wines by [COMPANY NAME]. The buyer pre-orders identified bottles, produced by Château Coutet, before they are made available. The digital certificate issued to the buyer (a token on the Stellar network) constitutes the receipt for the pre-order and the title to collect the bottles. It is neither a financial instrument nor a financial placement.

product.title: 2. Product and allocation
product.body: An Allocation comprises fifteen 75 cl bottles of the Les Demoiselles cuvée, Saint-Émilion Grand Cru: three bottles of each of the 2025 to 2029 vintages. Production comes from Château Coutet's Peycocut plots. In the event of an insufficient harvest for a vintage (frost, climate hazard, force majeure), the Allocation is carried over to the following vintage.

price.title: 3. Price and payment
price.body: The price is 905 euros excluding tax per Allocation, i.e. 60.33 euros excluding tax per bottle, payable in USDC on the Stellar network at the time of the pre-order. [APPLICABLE VAT REGIME TO BE SPECIFIED]. The price includes bonded storage at Bordeaux City Bond and AXA insurance until each vintage is made available.

delivery.title: 4. Availability, delivery and buy-back
delivery.body: The bottles of each vintage N are made available no later than 1 June of year N+2. From that date, the buyer may, for each vintage: request delivery to the address of their choice (delivery costs and conditions specified when the delivery is ordered, legal age verified on receipt), keep their bottles, transfer them, or accept the producer's buy-back offer. [BUY-BACK CONDITIONS AND FLOOR PRICE TO BE SPECIFIED ACCORDING TO THE PRODUCER'S COMMITMENT].

withdrawal.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body: [TO BE VALIDATED BY COUNSEL: the 14-day right of withdrawal regime applicable to distance selling, and its possible exceptions]. The terms of exercise and the withdrawal form appear in the appendix.

age.title: 6. Legal age
age.body: The sale of alcohol is prohibited to minors. The buyer declares that they are of legal age at the time of the pre-order; proof of legal age is required before any physical delivery.

certificate.title: 7. Digital certificate
certificate.body: The certificate is issued on the Stellar network in the wallet designated by the buyer, who is responsible for its custody. Transfer of the certificate entails transfer of the right to collect the corresponding bottles. [LIABILITY IN THE EVENT OF KEY LOSS TO BE SPECIFIED].

claims.title: 8. Claims and mediation
claims.body: Any claim may be sent to contact@terwa.io. Failing resolution, the consumer may refer the matter free of charge to the consumer mediator designated in the legal notice, or to the European online dispute resolution platform.

law.title: 9. Applicable law
law.body: These terms are governed by French law. [COMPETENT JURISDICTION TO BE SPECIFIED].

privacy.metaDescription: How TERWA processes personal data: wallet address, delivery details, retention periods, cookies and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

data.heading: Data processed
data.body: Public Stellar wallet address (necessary to perform the pre-order, inherently recorded on a public ledger), age declaration, and, at the time of a delivery: identity, postal address, email address and proof of legal age. Delivery details are encrypted; only their fingerprint (hash) is recorded on the public ledger.

purposes.heading: Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body: Performance of the sale contract (pre-order, availability, delivery, buy-back), compliance with legal obligations (legal age, anti-money-laundering, international sanctions), and handling of claims.

retention.heading: Retention periods
retention.body: Delivery data is kept [DURATION] after the last availability. Accounting records are kept for ten years in accordance with the law.

cookies.heading: Cookies and trackers
cookies.body: The site uses neither advertising cookies nor third-party trackers. Browser local storage is used only for technical preferences. [TO BE UPDATED IF AUDIENCE MEASUREMENT TOOLS ARE ADDED].

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.bodyPrefix: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability over your data, to be exercised at
rights.bodySuffix: . You may lodge any complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr). Entries on a public ledger such as a blockchain are inherently immutable: personal data is never written there in clear text.
